gen-gf-coming-soon-fs-merriweather-sans: Coming Soon looks scribbled by hand, its round o's and lowercase crowding the capitals. Merriweather Sans stands taller and sturdier underneath, with an e whose opening faces clearly right, so a long page reads firmly.
gen-gf-coming-soon-fs-ranade: Ranade spreads its sans-serif letters wide, with stroke ends held well apart and only a slight swell in the weight. And Coming Soon earns its place big and brief, where its bent-wire roundness can wander.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-abeezee: Loose, hand-scribbled warmth meets tidy lettering with a high mean line. Coming Soon is best at casual personality; ABeeZee is best at friendly, open terminals.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-aldrich: Aldrich keeps its lowercase almost as tall as its capitals. Over a long passage its cupped round letters feel crisp and modern, a firm counterweight to the loose pen-and-paper looseness of Coming Soon.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-alexandria: Coming Soon draws every letter at a single stroke weight, with no thick-and-thin at all, like a note jotted by hand. Big and brief is where it belongs.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-amiko: Amiko reads tall and sturdy, its terminals flaring outward like tongs. But Coming Soon is the one for casual handwriting, while Amiko handles the steadier, quieter work of text.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-anek-bangla: Anek Bangla reads wide and friendly, its s curves barely curling inward and its ascenders sitting close. And over a long passage it feels easygoing and open, a good foil for the constant line of Coming Soon.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-anek-devanagari: Anek Devanagari reads openly, with distinct letter mouths and a tall middle zone. Anek Devanagari holds up over a long passage, while Coming Soon keeps its line width through every turn, like a pen that never lifts.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-anek-gujarati: Anek Gujarati has lowercase that rivals its capitals and a gaping c. Anek Gujarati does the dependable text work, while Coming Soon glides along like wire and handles casual, personal moments.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-anek-gurmukhi: A pen-and-paper looseness with no thick-thin modulation defines Coming Soon. Anek Gurmukhi brings big open counters and generous curves, though shrink the heading and that handwritten charm would fade.
